item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Spot On 1.0.17
item.description:
Mac Fixed Application Shortcut Keys

Spot On is a keyboard launcher for macOS 14 and later that allows you to assign fixed keys to frequently used apps. Hold down Caps Lock and then press the corresponding letter, number, or symbol to go directly to the target application without having to enter a search term, look for a Dock icon, or repeatedly press Command-Tab. The same set of hotkeys performs different actions depending on the application's status: it launches the application if it is not yet running, brings it to the foreground if it is open but not in the foreground, and cycles through the application's windows if it is already in the foreground. Window cycling can be limited to the current desktop or can cover all desktops. The software offers over 40 key positions. Upon first launch, you can quickly assign letters to five applications. Press Caps Lock plus the spacebar to view the mappings. Keyboard shortcuts do not change based on recent usage order or window position, and can also be kept consistent across multiple Macs via iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or other synced folders. Spot On is natively built with SwiftUI, is compatible with existing Hyper shortcuts, and also offers the option to set a single press of Caps Lock as Escape.

item.title: Murmur 1.0.31
item.description:
macOS Text-to-Speech Software

Murmur is a native AI voice studio for macOS that converts scripts into natural-sounding speech and performs voice generation, cloning, and design on your computer, reducing reliance on cloud services, character limits, and ongoing subscriptions. Users can choose built-in or community voices, assign voices to different characters, import text or files, adjust speech speed and expression, and edit individual sentences, arrange pauses, and handle multi-speaker content on the project timeline. The software supports exporting to WAV, and the Mac version can also export to M4A. Projects and batch queues are suitable for creating podcasts, audiobooks, video voiceovers, courses, and game dialogues. The Kokoro model is provided with the application, and other speech models can be downloaded as needed. The optional OmniVoice models cover more than 600 languages, with actual language support varying by model. After the model installation is complete, speech generation can run offline, and the scripts, generated audio, and cloned materials are kept locally. Murmur also offers command-line and MCP automation capabilities, which can be used for script batch processing and AI agent workflows.

item.title: Iconscape 1.2.16
item.description:
Mac wallpapers that change with icons

Iconscape is a macOS dynamic wallpaper app that changes with the layout of desktop icons. It generates landscapes such as bays, meadows in the clouds, city blocks, or ski slopes based on the position and size of the screen and icons. After dragging a file, the terrain adjusts accordingly. Adjacent icons can share an island or a rooftop, and the icons and their names remain clearly visible at all times. After enabling "Follow Desktop Stacking," the landscape will also adapt to the stacking position and the files displayed when expanded. The wallpaper can switch between day and night based on the local sunset time or the macOS dark mode. After nightfall, window lights, lanterns, and campfires will illuminate. Once the landscape has been rendered, macOS drives the animations of scene elements such as swimmers, cable cars, and fireflies. These animations automatically pause when the desktop is obscured by windows or when Low Power Mode is enabled. Multiple monitors can each set their own scenes and be paused independently, and the app will also set a static snapshot for the lock screen. Iconscape resides in the menu bar and reads icon positions and sizes through Finder, with the relevant data stored locally. The app supports macOS 14 Sonoma and later versions and is compatible with both Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs.

item.title: ByeCtrlClick 27.1
item.description:
macOS Global Disable Ctrl+Left Click

ByeCtrlClick is a lightweight menu bar tool for macOS 15 and later that prevents context menus from popping up when you hold down the Ctrl key and left-click. Once enabled, the blocking takes effect globally in applications such as Finder, browsers, and games. The menu can still be opened normally by right-clicking with the mouse or tapping with two fingers on the trackpad. In the menu bar, a smiley face indicates that blocking is enabled, and a square-eyed emoji indicates that blocking is paused. Click the switch to toggle. In games like Minecraft, where the Ctrl key is bound to sprinting or crouching, players can click while holding down the Ctrl key to prevent the system menu from interrupting their actions. Game Mode can also keep the Mac awake, pause Time Machine backups, display the Metal performance monitoring overlay, or quit user-selected apps. After installation, you need to grant accessibility permissions in the system settings to allow the software to filter mouse events system-wide. This permission can be revoked at any time. The app does not require an account to be registered, nor does it collect usage data or perform analytical statistics.

item.title: FocusCursor 3.6.0
item.description:
macOS Cursor Highlighting Tool

FocusCursor: Highlight & Markup is a mouse highlighting and screen annotation tool for macOS, suitable for conference presentations, classroom teaching, and video tutorial production. It helps viewers clearly see the cursor's position, movement trajectory, and click actions. The software can display a following circle or ring around the cursor, emphasize actions with click animations, and use a mouse mask to dim other areas of the screen, focusing attention on the current point of discussion. Screen drawing supports lines, rectangles, circles, ellipses, and markers. You can adjust the color, line width, and fill of certain shapes. Selected drawing objects can be moved or deleted, making it easy to highlight key points during presentations. Mouse effects can be used in combination. You can save settings for different follow effects separately, adjust the intensity and center offset, and use SF Symbols as custom follow particle images. The software supports multiple monitors and can keep the mouse effect visible in the full-screen space of other applications. The particles will stop following the cursor when it is stationary. Combined with the menu bar entry, shortcut key toggle, startup, and hide Dock icon options, it can be easily enabled as needed for presentations.

item.title: Sequence 1.4.4
item.description:
Mac Podcast Post-Production

Sequence Tool is a native Mac editing tool for podcasts, interviews, and narrative video production. It helps creators first identify the story from the transcript, then organize the rough cut and export the final video. The software transcribes audio and video locally on the device, allowing you to search through the entire recording and adjust sentences and segments via text editing. Filler words, silences, profanity, and suggested re-recordings can also be reviewed, and the editing process does not alter the original footage. Users can create independent variants of the same long recording, such as the main cut, clean version, chapters, and social media clips, and separately manage text edits, markers, audio, and visual composition. The tool also supports loudness normalization, speaker identification, multi-camera synchronization and sequencing, media layers, and linked variants. It can export video or audio directly or hand it off to Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Project data is stored in an encrypted local database, with the option to back up the project library using iCloud. The original media itself is not encrypted by Sequence. The software is suitable for creators who want to reduce the time spent on initial editing of long footage, reuse interview content, and retain editorial autonomy. It also offers optional command-line tools and automated MCP connections.

item.title: ArtCraft Studio 0.41.1
item.description:
macOS Open Source Creation Kit

ArtCraft Craft Apps is an open-source suite of applications from the ArtCraft team, consisting of 17 standalone tools written from scratch in Rust. The suite covers image editing, vector illustration, video editing, RAW photo processing, PDF management, motion graphics and visual effects, 2D animation, desktop publishing, interface prototyping, 3D texture painting, procedural materials, and audio production. It also provides tools for word processing, slideshow presentations, CAD drafting, spreadsheets, and software exploration. Each application offers native installation packages for macOS, Windows, and Linux, without relying on Electron or embedded web views, and maintains layouts, tools, and keyboard shortcuts familiar to professional users. Desktop applications handle local files directly, eliminating the need to upload projects to the cloud. They can be installed and updated centrally via the ArtCraft Launcher, or downloaded individually as needed. With the exception of FilmCraft, the remaining 16 applications are available in WebAssembly-based browser versions. The kit supports automation via the command line, JSON control channel, or MCP server.

item.title: OhMyShot 0.4.0
item.description:
Open-source screenshot and screen recording tool for Mac

OhMyShot is a native, open-source screen capture tool for Macs with Apple silicon, compatible with macOS 26 and later versions. It resides in the menu bar, does not poll when idle, and does not maintain a screen capture session. Screen capture supports cross-screen selection, windows, full screen, timed, and scrolling long screenshots. The screen can be frozen during selection, making it easy to capture content that appears briefly. After taking a screenshot, you can copy, save, drag out, or paste it onto the screen from the quick access card. You can also add arrows, numbers, and highlights, or blur and pixelate sensitive information. The built-in on-device text recognition feature can copy and translate text in images in situ, and can also search the history based on the content of screenshots. Optional model packages can further process Chinese, formulas, tables, and charts. Screen recordings can be exported as MP4 or GIF files, with support for system audio, microphone, and camera. After recording, they can be edited in Studio and enhanced with automatic zooming that follows the cursor. The software also offers pinned overlays, screen color picking, an edge-snapping pixel ruler, as well as shortcuts and Raycast integration. OhMyShot brings together screenshots, screen recordings, annotations, and on-device text recognition in the macOS menu bar.

item.title: MacLC 1.9
item.description:
Free, open-source media player for Mac

MacLC is a native, open-source video player for Apple Silicon Macs, built on the VLC playback engine. It supports MKV, MP4, AVI, WebM, TS, AV1, HEVC, FLAC, DTS, and various subtitle formats, without the need to install additional codecs. It can render Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10, and HLG content, and can expand standard SDR video to the brightness range of HDR screens; It features nine built-in GPU upscaling methods, frame interpolation that matches the highest screen refresh rate, and Voice Boost to enhance dialogue. In addition to local video and music libraries, MacLC also offers content browsing based on third-party extension catalogs, torrent playback while downloading, YouTube and web video playback via yt-dlp, and AirPlay and Chromecast casting, which are still in the testing phase. The player includes real-time playback statistics, visual comparison, an equalizer, and various sound effect modes, with an interface designed in the native macOS style.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.13.4
item.description:
Menu Bar Icon Hiding Tool

Hidden Bar is a tool for hiding macOS menu bar icons. How to use: Hold down the `⌘ Command` key in the menu bar, and two icons will appear, "｜" and ">". Then, drag the icon you want to collapse to the left of the "｜" icon. Click the ">" arrow icon to expand/collapse the menu bar icons. However, pay attention to a logical issue: the ">" icon cannot be placed to the left of the "｜" icon, as it cannot fold itself in.

item.title: Switch 1.0.0
item.description:
Window-level ⌘Tab switcher for macOS

Switch is a window switcher for macOS that changes the usual ⌘-Tab behavior from app-level to window-level cycling. Use ⌘-Tab to go forward, ⇧⌘Tab to go back, and ⌥-` to cycle windows within an app, including across multiple Spaces. Windows appear in a vertical list you can filter by typing. A Sticky mode lets you preview a window without committing to the switch, and shortcuts let you close a window (⌘W), quit an app (⌘Q) or hide it (⌘H). It is free, open source, notarized, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: Itsytv 1.9.1
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Apple TV Remote Control Tool

Itsytv is a native open source app that brings Apple TV remote control to the macOS menu bar for users who need to quickly control their TV, type text, and manage playback status on a Mac. It connects to Apple TV through the same local network protocol as Siri Remote, providing direction keys, confirmation, return, home page, playback pause, and volume control, responding directly and without relying on cloud services. Users can use a compact hover panel for remote control, keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Return, Backspace, Escape, and Spacebar, and enter content in the Apple TV text box in real time. Apps showcase the cover, title, artist, and progress of your current playback, and the built-in app launcher lists installed apps, gets icons, and supports drag-and-drop sorting. Itsytv supports pairing and switching between multiple Apple TVs, automatically starting for different device memory panel locations, setting global shortcuts, and logging in.

item.title: TabFlick 0.27.1
item.description:
Mac Browser Tab Switcher

TabFlick is a browser tab switching and unified search tool for macOS that works with browser extensions through native apps to provide a recent Arc-like switching experience for Chrome, Edge, Brave, and other Chromium browsers. Hold down Control and tap Tab to browse the tabs, release the button to confirm the switch, make the round trip between the two commonly used pages more stable, and do not mistakenly mark the passing tag as used. The software supports page thumbnails, landscape bars, and grid layouts, and preserves a separate order of use by window. The search panel can centrally find open and recently closed tags, bookmarks, history, favorite folders, and installed apps. It supports full Chinese spelling and phonetic initial matching, single-character spelling error tolerance, and sorting according to the selection record. Users can also invoke cross-browser search from any app, perform link copying, page reload, repeat tag cleaning, and folder opening. Fixed label recovery, automatic cleanup of idle labels, menu bar lists, and custom shortcuts further simplify day-to-day management.

item.title: lux 1.51.0
item.description:
Cross-platform command-line download tool

lux is an open-source command-line program, similar to youtube-dl. It is used to download videos from YouTube.com and some other video sites. It offers a wide range of options that allow users to download videos according to their needs, such as selecting video quality, format, or downloading audio only, etc. lux supports multithreaded downloads, which can improve download speed. In addition, it supports multiple operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and Linux. In terms of usage, it requires a certain level of command-line knowledge, but its powerful features and flexibility make it the preferred tool for downloading online videos.

item.title: Bandizip365 7.40
item.description:
A powerful and versatile decompression tool for macOS

Bandizip is a fast decompression tool that offers a wide range of features and an intuitive user interface, and supports the macOS operating system. Users can easily extract common compressed file formats such as ZIP, 7-zip (7z), RAR (including RAR7), EGG, and ALZ, with support for extracting over 30 compressed file formats. Bandizip currently offers a monthly subscription service that allows users to enjoy the same premium features as a one-time purchase, with a one-week free trial. Its main features include powerful compression, decompression, browsing, and editing capabilities, and it supports multiple operating system versions, such as Big Sur, Monterey, Ventura, and more. The software's compression feature uses multi-core technology to be 6 times faster than Finder, supports AES256 encryption, compression of files larger than 4GB, and can create multi-volume ZIP and 7z archives. When it comes to decompression, Bandizip supports multiple formats, allowing users to view archive file lists, select files to extract, and perform simple drag-and-drop operations. Bandizip is a compression and decompression tool for macOS that offers fast decompression speeds, rich features, and an intuitive user interface.

item.title: Movie Thumbnails Maker 5.10.0
item.description:
Video Movie Thumbnail Creator

Movie Thumbnails Maker is a powerful thumbnail generation tool for Mac designed for movie enthusiasts and content creators. It supports various video formats such as AVI, WMV, RM, MPG, TS, MKV, MOV, FLV, MP4, RMVB, ASF, 3GP, M4V, SWF, etc. With just one click, it can quickly extract multiple exciting frames from videos and generate beautiful movie overview images or GIFs. It supports customizing background colors, border colors, watermarks, metadata display, and network features. Flexible parameters such as grid cell size spacing, timestamp annotation, source image cropping, video start and end point settings, quick/precise addressing mode, and real-time video playback preview allow you to process multiple movie files at once and output various image formats such as BMP, PNG, TIFF, JPEG, and GIF. This enables you to easily create professional-grade movie poster-style thumbnail sets, giving you an immediate and intuitive grasp of the latest movie highlights without having to guess the plot content. It is a must-have tool for movie fans. An efficient one-stop solution for video creators, vloggers, and media organizers.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.18.0
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.56
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Picmal 2.4.0
item.description:
Offline Bulk Media Format Interchange Tool

Picmal is a lightweight offline media conversion compression artifact designed for Mac users with a one-time buyout lifetime mode (only 15. $99, no subscription, no renewal), completely local processing is never the same as traditional privacy, supports batch conversion of image, video, audio formats (PSD to PNG, AI to SVG, MOV to MP4, etc. almost cover common formats), can complete format conversion + volume compression + size adjustment at the same time, built-in common presets (web optimization, social media, archiving, etc.) and allows deep customization (color space, encoder, bitrate, remove meta number) Perfectly integrated Finder right-click menu, Quick Actions and Shortcuts, drag and drop folders or multi-select files to efficiently process hundreds of files, run extremely fast, compact, purely local, no network dependency, support macOS full version and adapt to Apple Silicon, highly praised by 220 + users, known as the best choice for easy-to-use, fast, alternative online tools and complex software, is a designer, content creator, developer Daily users save time and labor when processing batches of media files, and have a practical productivity tool that is permanently owned by one-time payment.

item.title: StepGrab 1.7.1
item.description:
Creating Step-by-Step Tutorials for macOS

StepGrab is a workflow recording and step-by-step tutorial generation tool that resides in the macOS menu bar. It automatically recognizes interactions as users click through workflows, captures screenshots for each click, numbers the steps, and generates coherent and accurate operating instructions, eliminating the repetitive work of taking screenshots one by one and manually writing documentation. It accurately captures menus, drop-down lists, pop-up windows, system selectors, double-clicks, keyboard shortcuts, and scroll indicators, and arranges the visuals with rounded corners and shadows that closely resemble native Mac windows. The app supports exporting the results as a looping GIF, an animated PDF, or an HD MP4. You can also adjust the color scheme, numbering style, layout, PDF quality, light or dark appearance, and add a brand logo. On-device AI can help generate more natural step-by-step instructions, while text recognition and element localization can improve the accuracy of menu and pop-up descriptions. The entire screen processing procedure is completed locally on the Mac. There is no need to upload the recorded content to the cloud, and you can start using it without an account.

item.title: NotchPad 2.2.3
item.description:
Liuhai Area Quick Note Tool

NotchPad is a Mac Security Notepad app designed for MacBook Liu Haiping that cleverly integrates notepads, clipboard history, and reusable snippets into the MacBook's Liuhai area, providing quick access with just a mouse hover without switching windows or interrupting current workflows. NotchPad supports rich text editing features, including bold, italics, lists, and other formats, so users can easily pin important notes to the top and quickly find what they need with an instant search. The app enables encryption protection by default, and all data is stored locally on your Mac and never sent to any server for privacy. NotchPad syncs with Apple Notes in both directions. Users can browse and edit Apple Notes in-app, and the changes are instantly returned to the native Notes app. It also supports more than 50 file types, including txt, Markdown, RTF, Word, PDF, and various code files such as Swift, Python, JavaScript, etc. After importing, it will retain a rich text format.

item.title: Qark 1.3.2
item.description:
Mac Ring Shortcut Menu

Qark is a radial menu tool for macOS that arranges frequently used apps, files, links, shortcuts, text, and groups around the mouse pointer, shortening the access path through circular entry points. By default, hold down Control, Option, and R, and release them after moving to the desired action to execute it. You can also record other keyboard shortcuts or use a mouse button other than the left button to bring up the menu and switch to the tap-and-click operation mode. The software offers seven designs and three materials – Plain, Frost Glass, and Liquid Glass – and allows you to customize the ring and slot content to tailor the interface layout to your personal work habits. Grouped items can be expanded sequentially from their respective slots. Seven interactive events, including opening, hovering, selecting, and closing, are all accompanied by sounds. Corresponding sound effects from other designs can also be selected. The Clean Keys slot can temporarily lock the keyboard for easy wiping and cleaning. The Ring configuration supports exporting and importing for convenient backup and restoration. On supported mice, you can also adjust the scroll wheel's notched or free-scrolling mode.

item.title: Keylume 2.4.3
item.description:
macOS Demo Keyboard Tool

Keylume is a stylish on-screen keyboard tool designed for macOS for screen recording and live demo scenes. Keylume provides a complete view of the Apple keyboard, including media keys, arrow keys, and all modifier keys, perfectly matching the look and layout of a real Apple keyboard, many other key visualization tools only show modifier key combinations or omit function keys, while Keylume shows the entire keyboard. Keylume has a variety of beautiful themes built in and an intuitive theme editor that makes it easy for users to create personalized styles, save themes, share them with others, or import themes made by others. Keylume automatically pops up at the start of screen recording and automatically hides after the recording stops, detecting the response in just one second, and also supports manually switching the display by tapping the fn key three times. Keylume supports hovering and tapping fn to enable auto-hiding mode, let the keyboard fade out and allow click penetration, and can freely drag and drag reposition and resize, position information will be automatically remembered. Users can set up app ignore lists to avoid repeated triggering of keyboard displays by background silent recording apps such as backup tools or picture-in-picture utilities.

item.title: Bloom 1.5.52
item.description:
Increase efficiency with multi-pane file management

Bloom is a productivity-enhancing alternative to Finder designed to provide users with a more streamlined and efficient file management experience. It has a number of powerful features, including a system-wide "Go to Folder" shortcut and keyword search capabilities, allowing users to quickly locate the files they need. Bloom's Portal window is designed to be compact and easy to use in multitasking, while allowing you to view the contents of a compressed file without decompressing it. The app also offers a variety of useful tools, including intelligent column width auto-adjustment, advanced renaming capabilities, iCloud Drive support, and easy folder manipulation. Bloom Mac is an improved Finder alternative designed to enhance user productivity and file management experience with powerful features and multi-pane layouts. It provides an intuitive way to search and manipulate files, enabling users to organize and access files more efficiently. Multi-pane layout: Bloom supports multi-pane layout, users can view and manage multiple folders at the same time, improve productivity. Quick search experience: With the shortcut ⌘ aves, users can quickly access the⇧ "Go to folder" function, which supports searching for files by keywords, and the search speed is extremely fast.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.5-beta.2
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: PasteNow 2.41
item.description:
Lightweight clipboard management tool for macOS

PasteNow is a Mac clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices and the reuse of historical data. It can intelligently categorize clipboard content based on rules and offers various list styles, such as grid views and simple lists, to display the content. Users can preview text, links, and images, and can also add sensitive apps to the exclusion list to protect their privacy. PasteNow relies on iCloud to achieve cloud-based data synchronization, ensuring that clipboard history can be shared across different devices. It also supports full keyboard operation and custom hotkeys to improve operational efficiency. Users can also collect and organize clipboard content using the drag-and-drop feature and selectively save data by setting exclusion rules, providing convenient preview and editing functions. PasteNow is a brand-new clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices, allowing users to easily reuse clipboard history data and categorize history content using rules. Content Preview: Preview clipboard text, links, and image content, with support for HEX color display. Rich views: Clipboard content can be displayed in a variety of styles, including grid view, simple list, and rich list.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.7-beta.3
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: Folders Mini 1.1.0
item.description:
macOS File Dialog Enhancements

Folders Mini is a file dialog enhancement tool for macOS 13 and later. It displays a complete folder tree alongside the system's standard Open and Save dialogs, allowing users to directly click on the target folder to navigate to it, reducing the need to search through each level of the path. The folder tree covers Favorites, Personal Home Folders, Internal and External Disks, Network Shares, and WebDAV, and also supports cloud storage locations such as iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Google Drive. When users switch directories within the dialog box, the selected state in the tree view will update accordingly, and changes to the folder structure will also be reflected in real time. The software supports adjusting themes, accent colors, font sizes, line spacing, sorting, and visibility, and provides indentation guides, tag colors, and custom folder icons. Settings can be synced across multiple Macs via iCloud. Using the folder context menu, you can also open directories in Finder or your preferred terminal, manage favorites, copy folders or paths, and set color and text labels. The buttons at the bottom control the display of hidden folders, software packages, and apps, and support both Simplified and Traditional Chinese;

item.title: Vitals 1.13.8
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: Snaggy 2.0
item.description:
Cross-browser bookmarking tool for macOS

Snaggy is a native bookmark management and read-later tool for macOS. It allows you to save the current web page from different browsers using a unified shortcut key, consolidating scattered links into a single library. The default shortcut key is ⌘D. It only takes over the bookmarking operation when the browser is in the foreground, and you can also change it yourself. The software supports importing browser bookmarks, pinned tabs, and HTML bookmark files, preserving the original folder structure for easy migration of existing favorites. On eligible Macs, it uses Apple's on-device model to automatically create folders and organize links; when the requirements are not met, it categorizes them by website. The built-in reader supports blocking ads and trackers, offers a reading mode for articles, automatically marks articles as read upon reaching the end, and can open web pages in the browser used when the link was saved. Users can search their favorites from the menu bar and use local MCP services to enable AI tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to search for and save links. The database is stored locally, and no account creation is required. You can choose to use your personal iCloud to sync across multiple Macs, and it supports exporting to JSON, CSV, and HTML.

item.title: Folders Pro 2.13.1
item.description:
macOS File Manager

Folders File Manager is a professional file manager for macOS. Centered around an expandable and sortable folder tree, it brings together local disks, network shares, iCloud Drive, various cloud storage services, tags, recent files, and favorites. It helps users transitioning from Windows to Mac maintain their familiar resource management habits, and also allows power users who need a clear directory hierarchy to browse and organize files more efficiently. . The software offers four viewing modes: Grid, List, Icons, and Gallery, and can remember display settings by folder. It supports folder priority, file priority, and grouping by attributes. It builds a smooth workflow through tabs, multiple windows, savable tab groups, an editable path bar, quick previews, and an info panel. It covers cut-and-paste, conflict comparison and folder merging, batch renaming, blank file and document creation, network share mounting, Spotlight or full-disk search, file collection and compression operations, and can view audio and video, EXIF, permissions, and other metadata.

item.title: DockDuck 1.1.12
item.description:
Dual-pane file manager for macOS

DockDuck is a native macOS file manager written entirely in Swift, compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and requiring macOS 15 Sequoia or later. It focuses on fast launch, low resource use and smooth browsing, combining tabs, pinned files, tags, instant search, smart folders, panes and workspaces in one window. Dual-pane and multi-column views suit side-by-side browsing, moving and comparing, and folder comparison shows identical, modified or one-sided items. It also offers batch renaming, a file shelf, compression and extraction, image conversion, PDF merging, folder sync, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV and FTP support, and SSH key access to remote files, plus grid, list, column and gallery views, live preview, remappable shortcuts, and terminal and editor integration.
